verses.mystical_translation: Why standest you afar off, O the Living Presence? why hidest you thyself in times of trouble?
The patterns rooted in harm in his pride does persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
For the patterns rooted in harm boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the the Living Presence abhorreth.
The patterns rooted in harm, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after the Divine: the Divine is not in all his thoughts.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
He has said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
He sits in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places does he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he does catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
He has said in his heart, the Divine has forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
Arise, O the Living Presence; O the Divine, lift up your hand: forget not the humble.
Wherefore does the patterns rooted in harm contemn the Divine? he has said in his heart, You will not require it.
You have seen it; for you beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with your hand: the poor committeth himself to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.
Break you the arm of the patterns rooted in harm and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till you find none.
The the Living Presence is King for ever and ever: the nations are perished out of his land.
the Living Presence, you have heard the desire of the humble: you will prepare their heart, you will cause your ear to hear:
To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

contemplative_note: The prayer names systems of predation clearly and refuses to let hidden harm remain invisible.
safety_note: The psalm describes predatory abuse of the poor; it should strengthen protection of vulnerable people, not stigmatize poverty.
